# These events give you Legendary Cores for Legendary Crafting (Rolls)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_98_nukaknights-post-legendary-cores-events.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

To create legendary weapons and armor, you need legendary cores and legendary modules (with a few exceptions). To "roll" a 3* weapon you need e.g. 5 Legendary Cores and 4 Legendary Modules. You can get legendary modules in exchange for legendary bills from the legendary dealer in Rusty Pick and during expeditions. You can read here how and where you can get legendary cores.

## Where do you get legendary cores?

**Legendary Cores** are received as rewards from **Events** and **Daily Operations**:

- "**Cryptic** ", "**A colossal problem** ":**8 cores**
- "**Scorched Earth** " (Queen):**5 cores**
- "**Project Paradise** " & "**Free Range** " give**4-8 cores** (8 if all 3 animals are still alive)
- The seasonal **Mothman Equinox** gives up to**4 cores**
- **Daily Operations** have a chance to get**1-3 cores** (Oldest Rank)
- No cores from gifts or buckets
- "**Meat Week**" and "**Fasnacht**": 1-2 cores for a "good" result, **1-3 cores** for a "best" result
- All other **public events** also have a chance of **1-3 legendary cores**
- Legendary Cores cannot be traded or discarded.

## Tip: Farm cryptically

If you want to farm legendary cores very efficiently and quickly and have a small team of players, you can farm the “Cryptic” event very well.

To start Kryptisch you need an **Aggressotron Recall Keycard**, which you can buy from all merchants at train stations. After purchase, it must be made at a **craft workbench** with Fluxen. You can only buy the key cards once you have completed the **"Van Lowe" quest**. Read the posters at the train stations with the Sheepsquatch and the inscription “Sheepsquatch ate my brother”.

You start the event at the “Pylon Ambush” in Ash Heap (southeast of Rusty Pick). The event has a cooldown of around 3 hours and is therefore not always guaranteed to start on public servers.

To farm cryptically with Fallout 1st (private server), follow these steps:

- Form a team with fellow players who have a number of Aggressotron Recall Key Cards ready
- One of you starts a private server (Fallout 1st) 
(Make sure that the others can join you. So either form a team in the main menu or set the server to "Friends")
- Gather at the ambush pylon
- Starts the event
- Receive **8 Legendary Cores** upon completion
- Now you leave this server
- Another player from your team starts a new private server
- You all join together again and start the event again
- This way you can start a series of private servers (2 players with Fallout 1st are enough) and start the event immediately every time.

If you're quick, you can farm up to 100 Legendary Cores in **one hour**.

## Farming Legendary Cores

If you don't have a team ready at the moment and want to farm legendary cores at the same time, that's also possible. Pay attention to which events you do and trigger yourself.

- Only plays public events
- Trigger Cryptic in public as often as you can
- Find servers without nuke zones and launch nuclear missiles at the Queen (5 legendary cores) or Earle (8 legendary cores) between public events (on the hour, 20 after and 40 after).
- Look for e.g. via Discord Groups that do Queen Runs and join together there to take part, like ours: Nuka Knights Discord
- The more endgame events you play, the faster you will get legendary cores

## Conclusion

Without legendary cores, legendary crafting becomes difficult. This becomes a problem on characters you don't play often. With the methods mentioned you can also systemically use these characters
